text:
Maria: Observed duplicate GETs from web sample when token refresh is slow — two calls for the same cursor within 25ms, second gets 429.
Jordan: Sounds like prefetch + auth retry are replaying requests. Which SDK/version?
Maria: JS sample using @redwood/sdk v2.1.4. Repro: fast scroll + force token expire.
Sam: quick patch for sample: simple inflight map to dedupe identical fetches. Example: const m = new Map(); function dedupe(key, fn){ if(m.has(key)) return m.get(key); const p = fn().finally(()=>m.delete(key)); m.set(key,p); return p }
Maria: validated: 100 rapid scrolls, token latency 700ms -> 20% 429s without dedupe, 0 with dedupe.
Jordan: SDK parity note: python/go don't prefetch; JS does. Suggest adding an opt-in SDK flag `dedupeInFlight` (default false) + docs about prefetch/auth interaction.
Liam: infra input: server-side cheap dedupe would help but is a bigger change. For now client-side is fine.
Sam: I'll open PR with flag + tests (concurrent callers, auth stub, memory leak check).
devex-bot: created DEVEX-6102 "js-sdk: inflight dedupe option + prefetch auth docs"
Maria: thanks — I'll enable in sample-app dev build and run stress tests once PR lands.
Jordan: follow-up: audit other sample apps (mobile/desktop) for same pattern.
Sam: on it.
